formats: SPM2; task v4 / basis v3 / overlay v3 unchanged
scope: Same small editorless None fixture. Two separate ABBA blocks; do not pool variants or attribute all wall-clock variation to the fixes.

changes.cause: Fresh immutable adoption trees immediately entered full copying/relocation collection.
changes.change: Under a read fence that excludes writer/GC, verify complete ordered flat root, each native container owner, every page checksum/logical hash/count and exact contiguous physical coverage. Skip copying only if every byte belongs to that root.
changes.fallback: Existing collection/locations/receipts, child trees, unknown controls, unreachable/torn tails and unowned header initialization use ordinary same-request collection or existing preserve/refuse behavior. Reachable corruption is rejected. No persistent cached proof or new receipt/format.

changes.cause: Required content was sorted and materialized as another metadata tree even when tiny.
changes.change: Fully drain and validate exact identity/value pairs into a shared-budget memory dictionary; disk-sort/tree fallback on local or shared budget exhaustion. Release dictionary capacity before returning its charge. Native/live/pending/retained references remain included before deletion.

changes.cause: The first empty source response repeated the just-completed full provider proof, then paid a fixed 100ms poll.
changes.change: Retain full initial/final and one-second periodic proofs; poll every 20ms for the first 100ms and then every 100ms. Unique request/token/PID/start/snapshot and bound reader checks remain.

input.limits: Later edit timestamps/IDs differ. OS caches not cleared. Entry-point phase sums exclude driver/sampling/dispatch; whole workflow includes them. Nested diagnostics are not additive.

variantNotes: Intermediate b1/b2 used the default 100ms response poll and lacked final dictionary-capacity release and unowned-header fallback refinements. Final c1/c2 are the exact current product binaries.
limits: No large input or retained 100k/17GiB fixture, Git/Plastic/Unity native lifecycle, OS crash, maximum RSS/hardware saturation or full build.ps1 gate.
Small component improvements do not prove that the historical tens-of-minutes/hours behavior is resolved; SCAL-03/07/08 remain incomplete.
Live source observation, retained reference enumeration, capture freezing and backend completion still contribute. Full native/content/reader proofs and durable publication order remain.

conclusion.componentBenefit: Both final candidate runs reduce adoption maintenance and complete alias cleanup relative to both final controls; full inventory/native proofs and durable publication order remain.
conclusion.interpretation: Final whole mean is 4.9% slower despite component reductions. Only two runs per final candidate; unchanged publication/final-maintenance variability is unresolved. Intermediate block is not pooled or substituted.

remainingCostDiagnosis.interpretation: Both intervals are outside the changed adoption-maintenance path. An earlier baseline also slowed there; this locates variability without establishing disk, antivirus or another cause. No additional trial selected a favorable result.
